units.source_text: 对局期间，名人的弟子村岛五段一直住在旅馆，常同名人会晤。

en.t: During the match, the Master's disciple Murashima 5-dan stayed at the inn the whole time and often met with the Master.

units.source_text: 这种做法有损于胜负艺术的庄严，大竹七段大概早就生气了。

en.t: This way of doing things damaged the solemn dignity of the art of contest, and Otake 7-dan had probably been angry about it for some time.

units.source_text: 前田六段是名人的弟子，也是七段的妹夫，他即使到箱根来，也不在名人的房间里留宿，住在另一家旅馆。

en.t: Maeda 6-dan was the Master's disciple and also the 7-dan's brother-in-law, but even when he came to Hakone, he did not stay overnight in the Master's room; he stayed at another inn.

units.source_text: 对局条件本是严肃的，企图把它纠缠在友谊或人情之上改变它，这也使七段怒意难消。

en.t: The conditions of the match were serious by nature, and trying to alter them by entangling them with friendship or personal feeling also made it hard for the 7-dan's anger to subside.
